audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Yone Levels 3, 4-5 and First item and called Level 2 a skill fight, while every content why in those rows says Sett and the packet chart agrees.
audit.why: This is Sett's best matchup on the list at 55.71% over 3838 games. Facebreaker reaches 490 against Mortal Steel's 450 and Yone's frame stays squishy until two crit items.
audit.corrected: Sett through First item, Yone at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].why described Sterak's making Sett unburstable in the row that belongs to Yone.
audit.why: Yone's two-item spike is Mortal Steel every 4 seconds plus Fate Sealed flanking from 1000 range — durability items do not answer either.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] asserted 'He can't spirit-form E out of your CC once he's committed', and breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers.
audit.why: Riot's text says Soul Unbound forces his spirit back to his body when it ends — it is a return to a known location, which is the usable fact. Whether CC prevents the return is not in the data and should not be claimed.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the return-to-body positioning tell plus Soul Unbound's 22s-to-10s cooldown and Mortal Steel's flat 4s.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Soul Unbound and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Two crit items and Yone dashes in on Mortal Steel every 4s and flanks 1000 units with Fate Sealed. Fight only with Facebreaker up.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. E-stun him there. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound (E): 22s to 10s — he is forced back to his body, so stand on it. - Mortal Steel (Q): flat 4s.

edits.before: E Facebreaker shuts down Yone's Q3 knockup dash — pull him in before he can gap-close and W him with a loaded Grit bar. He can't spirit-form E out of your CC once he's committed, so punish every Q3 whiff and every wave-shove.
edits.after: Facebreaker (E) at 490 out-reaches Mortal Steel at 450, so you pull him in before the two-stack dash lands. Soul Unbound drags him back to the body he left — stand on that spot and Haymaker him the instant he reappears.

notes: The content whys already described the correct chart; only the side/rating tokens and two full-layer strings were out of step. The claim that CC prevents Yone's Soul Unbound return was removed rather than restated, since it is not in Riot's text.
